newsitem.title: UK: Dresdner Kleinwort loses Cater Takeover Panel case.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner Kleinwort loses Cater Takeover Panel case.

text.p: Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, the investment banking arm of Dresdner Bank, has lost an appeal over a Takeover Panel ruling that it should not advise financial services group Cater Allen Holdings plc on its merger with banking group Abbey National plc.

On Tuesday, the Panel upheld the decision of its executive that Dresdner Kleinwort Benson was not "an appropriate person to provide ... independent advice" as required by the Takeover Code because of the firm's relationship to Abbey National.
The Panel praised Kleinwort for raising the issue itself and said the fact that the firm's appeal had been dismissed was "in no sense a criticism of Kleinworts."

The Takeover Panel said Kleinworts have been Abbey's financial advisers since the 1980s and a recent senior executive at Kleinworts has been a non-executive director of Abbey National for a number of years.
The Panel noted that Kleinwort Benson Securities had also acted as broker to Abbey since its flotation in 1989.

"In the panel's view, Kleinworts has a close, recent and continuing advisory relationship with (Abbey National," the panel said in a statement. It said advisers must be "in fact, and who would widely be regarded as being, independent of the offeror."
